Messages.Author: Xian
Messages.Body:
Something that came up this weekend:

A minion had a few (3 I believe) Ghoul Retainers on it. Combat inevitably
ensued. The minion with the retainers had 2 weapons, one that the vampire
used, and another weapon that all three Ghoul Retainers used. The opposing
minion dodged.

Assuming that the weapon strikes were valid at whatever range the combat is
occuring:

*Do the Ghoul Retainers each have to use a different weapon, or may they all
use the same weapon, as long as the employing minion is not using it?

*If the opposing minion dodges, he avoids the first minion's strike, but he
cannot dodge the retainers' strikes, correct? Their damage is
quasi-environmental, or something?

Xian

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <3ZfZ5.4386$sZ4.4...@news.uswest.net>,

"Xian" <xi...@waste.org> wrote:
> Something that came up this weekend:
>
> A minion had a few (3 I believe) Ghoul Retainers on it. Combat
> inevitably ensued. The minion with the retainers had 2 weapons,
> one that the vampire used, and another weapon that all three Ghoul
> Retainers used. The opposing minion dodged.

Note on answer that follows: All retainers following the rulings
for Wolf Companion, as appropriate.

> Assuming that the weapon strikes were valid at whatever range
> the combat is occuring:
>
> *Do the Ghoul Retainers each have to use a different weapon, or may
> they all use the same weapon, as long as the employing minion is not
> using it?

They may all use the same weapon at the same time.
Thank Tom Wylie.

From http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulings.html :

Ghoul Retainer - Retainer (2)
Read as "Each round of combat, Ghoul uses hands for 1 damage or a
weapon of the employing minion that the minion is not presently using."
[RTR 19941109]
More than one Ghoul Retainer employed by a Minion could "use" the same
weapon (that the Minion is not using) at the same time. [TOM 19950921]

> *If the opposing minion dodges, he avoids the minion's strike,

> but he cannot dodge the retainers' strikes, correct?

Retainers don't get strikes. They do damage.
This damage will not be avoided by dodge or prevented by
"Card: Prevent Damage From a Strike".

Damage from retainers can never be dodged.

"The damage is not a strike, so cannot be prevented by
a dodge. [RTR 19941109] "

Also, the Ghoul Retainer will not do damage again that round
with the weapon if their controller gets extra strikes.

The only way to avoid the damage is Strike: Combat Ends,
and being at the wrong range for the damage done by the retianer.

> Their damage is quasi-environmental, or something?

Or something.
Environmental damage is not mentioned in the rules at all.
It is simply a description of damage that does not come from
the minion even though it may come from cards played on
or by the minion.

Carpe Noctem.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Retainer damage is done during the normal strike resolution phase.
Other "during strike resolution" effects are also done during normal
strike resolution (cf. Carrion Crows).
All of these effects are simultaeous with one another.

If you make a normal (as opposed to First Strike) strike, then all
of those effects are resolved simultaenously with the strike, as
well.

The 3 Ghouls could use the Flamethrower to deal 6R agg (plus whatever
damage your strike does).
